LanguageData.TM_LastCircleDetails: Requires a melee weapon. The four nearest allies each absorb up to 25 damage over 20s. Three sweeps hit up to three enemies each. Movement speed −30%. Leaving the circle ends the stance. Explosions bypass protection. Interrupted preparation costs 6% stamina and locks the technique for 6000 ticks.
